title: Image uploads: a path traced with the pointer, and 'this one' is the slow part
persona: A backend engineer at a photo-sharing app explaining where uploads get slow, pointing more than labelling.
realism: At a whiteboard people trace a request with a finger and say 'this one' instead of naming things.

steps.say: So the photo leaves the phone.
And the metadata gets written down here too.
So a request goes here, then here, then here, and ends up here.
I think this one is the slow part, it does all three sizes before answering.
And this one I'm not sure is even in the hot path.

story: The path they traced while saying 'here, then here, then here' is Mobile app → Edge → Resizer → Blob store.
The box they called 'the slow part' ('this one') is the Resizer.
The box they are not sure is in the hot path ('this one I'm not sure') is the Metadata DB, which they then made dashed.
partner_should_ask_about: whether the Resizer answers before or after making all sizes
whether the metadata write is synchronous
